excerpt: How to Reduce Employee Turnover and Increase Employee Retention Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. Building trust between management and employees is essential for every successful business. In today’s fast-changing workplace, trust leads to better teamwork, higher employee satisfaction, and stronger company performance. Whether you are a manager, business owner, or employee, understanding how to create and maintain trust at work is key to long-term success. Why Trust Matters in the Workplace Improved Teamwork: Employees are more willing to collaborate and support each other. Higher Productivity: People work harder
